sectionTitle: Morality, Hiddenness, and the Evidential Force of Evil

lockedMove.speaker: Victor Stenger
lockedMove.excerpt: could deliberately hide from us or if he wanted to by not making his presence known all but a select few like Evangelical Christians but that would be an evil God an immoral God a God who Dooms everyone but his favorites to Everlasting torment a good god a moral God would not do that he make himself available to everybody so the very fact that there are non-believers in the world proves that God does not exist summarize the Judea Christian Islamic God can be scientifically shown not to exist Beyond A Reasonable Doubt by by the absence of evidence that should be there there
lockedMove.proposition: A good God would be available to everyone, so persistent nonbelief and missing expected evidence count against that God.
